name: Reset Winsock
description: Resets the Windows network stack to fix connection issues caused by corrupted settings, VPNs, or security software. This action restores standard protocols but may briefly interrupt internet access.

description_i18n.en: Resets the Windows network stack to fix connection issues caused by corrupted settings, VPNs, or security software. This action restores standard protocols but may briefly interrupt internet access.
description_i18n.de: Setzt das Netzwerkprotokoll von Windows zurück, um Verbindungsprobleme durch beschädigte Einstellungen, VPNs oder Sicherheitssoftware zu beheben. Dies stellt Standard-Protokolle wieder her und kann den Internetzugriff kurz unterbrechen.
description_i18n.fr: Réinitialise la pile réseau de Windows pour corriger les problèmes de connexion causés par des paramètres corrompus, des VPN ou un logiciel de sécurité. Cette action restaure les protocoles standards mais peut interrompre temporairement l'accès à internet.

warnings.title: Network interruption
warnings.message: Internet connectivity may be lost briefly while network protocols are being rebuilt

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the netsh winsock reset command to clear and rebuild the Winsock catalog registry keys
